module.Title: Store Player Health
module.Teaching: A variable is a named container. The int type stores whole numbers, which makes it a good fit for health.
module.PredictionQuestion: Which part tells C# to store a whole number?
module.PredictionExplanation: int is the data type for whole numbers.
module.DebugPrompt: The value is inside quotation marks, which makes it text instead of a number.
module.RecallPrompt: From memory, create playerHealth with a starting value of 100.
module.TransferPrompt: Create enemyHealth as a whole number starting at 30.
module.PreviewMessage: The player now begins with 100 health.
